gloss: decline in reading (of books and print)

definitions.gloss: decline in reading (of books and print)
definitions.explanation: People, especially young people, reading fewer books, newspapers and magazines; a stock topic in discussions of education and publishing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{活字離|かつじばな}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Young people are reading less and less.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧、{活字離|かつじばな}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: As smartphones spread, people began to talk about a decline in reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{活字離|かつじばな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯止|はど}め→歯止め：09326_hadome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけよう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、さまざまな⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Publishers are trying all kinds of ideas to halt the decline in reading.

notes:
⟦{活字|かつじ}→活字：00202_katsuji⟧ (printed type, print) + 〜⟦{離|ばな}れ→離れ：10003_banare⟧ (drifting away from), as in ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車離|くるまばな}れ (young people losing interest in cars).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{活字離|かつじばな}れ: young people turning away from reading
- {活字離|かつじばな}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: the decline in reading continues
- {活字離|かつじばな}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯止|はど}め→歯止め：09326_hadome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to halt the decline in reading

USAGE:
A media and education term. It usually means printed books and newspapers; surveys often point out that people read a great deal on screens.
